NOTE
**Still not ready — screenshot added, but no linked issue**

New: The author posted a before/after dark mode screenshot, which answers the screenshot feedback, but there was no new push. Missing: a "Fixes: #N" line (open issue #38931 looks like the match, but the PR doesn't link it, so its "help wanted" status can't be checked), and a description of how it was manually tested, including the new right-side arrow rule, which the screenshot doesn't show.

###### Next step

"not ready" stays, and laurynmm can give this feedback, or the triager can check whether #38931 is labeled "help wanted" before deciding.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the screenshots! Could you link the issue this fixes (e.g. "Fixes: #38931", if that's the one) and say how you tested it manually, including the new right-placement arrow case? The [guide on submitting a pull request](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/reviewable-prs.html) covers both.
```
